title: Notion Pricing Plans: Free, Plus, Business, & Enterprise.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page states that paying yearly saves up to 20% compared with monthly billing.
facts.quote: Save up to 20% with yearly

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page states that Custom Agents cost $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits after a free trial.
facts.quote: Free to try, then $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page says the Plus Plan, which has a 1-member limit, is free for students and educators.
facts.unit: members (limit on free student/educator Plus Plan)
facts.quote: The Plus Plan (with a 1-member limit) is free for students and educators.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page says paid plans are charged a fee per member, while guests are free of charge.
facts.quote: If you upgrade your workspace to one of the paid plans, you will be charged a fee per member.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page states that guests are free of charge but can only access individual pages they are invited to.
facts.quote: Guests are free of charge – but they can only access individual pages they are invited to.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page states that membership changes made mid-month create prorated charges based on the time remaining in the billing cycle.
facts.quote: Changes in membership that occur mid-month will create prorated charges based on the amount of time remaining in the billing cycle when the paid seat was added.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page says removing a member does not credit the account, and the removed seat remains usable for a different user for the rest of the billing period.
facts.quote: If you removed members, you will not receive credit but instead will still have use of that seat for a different user for the remainder of the billing period.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page says Notion AI will not use customer data to train its models unless the customer opts in to a request to share data.
facts.quote: Notion AI will not use your data to train our models unless you opt in to a request to share your data.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page says its AI subprocessors have contractual agreements prohibiting use of customer data to train their models.
facts.quote: We specifically have contractual agreements in place with our AI subprocessors that prohibit the use of customer data to train their models.

facts.fact: Notion's pricing page says it accepts all major credit and debit card brands as payment methods.
facts.quote: We currently accept all major credit and debit card brands.

facts.fact: The Free plan's plan-comparison table lists a file upload limit of up to 5 MB in its first column.
facts.quote:
File uploads

Up to 5 MB

facts.fact: On a Free Plan workspace used by a single person, there is no limit on how many pages and blocks can be added, while multi-member Free workspaces have a limited number of blocks.
facts.quote: If you’re using a Free Plan workspace by yourself, you’ll be able to add as many pages and blocks as you like.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that a paid seat is kept for the duration of the billing period once added.
facts.quote: Once you have added a paid seat, you will keep it for the duration of your billing period.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that at each billing renewal, the charge equals the plan amount multiplied by the number of members in the workspace, plus prorated charges for new paid seats added in the past month.
facts.quote: you will be charged for your plan amount multiplied by the number of members in your workspace, plus any prorated charges for new paid seats added in the past month.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that paid seats are recalculated at each renewal to match the number of members present in the workspace.
facts.quote: Your number of paid seats will be recalculated at each renewal to match the number of members present in the workspace.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that upgrading a plan takes effect immediately with the amount due reduced based on the percentage of the billing cycle left.
facts.quote: Your account will be upgraded and charged immediately. The amount due will be reduced based on the percentage of the billing cycle left at the time the plan was changed.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that downgrading a plan takes effect at the end of the billing cycle.
facts.quote: Your account will be downgraded at the end of your billing cycle.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that after cancelling, paid features remain accessible until the end of the billing cycle.
facts.quote: After you cancel, you’ll still have access to all the paid features until the end of your billing cycle.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that payments may be retried up to 8 times within the next month after a failed payment.
facts.quote: Payments may be retried up to 8 times within the next month.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that the account email is notified after each failed payment.
facts.quote: Your account email will be notified after each failed payment.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that a workspace whose payment still fails is restricted to limited access before being downgraded to the Free plan.
facts.quote: your workspace will get restricted to limited-access for a period of time before being downgraded to the Free plan.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states it will refund the full, non-prorated amount if a user downgrades within three days of signing up for monthly billing.
facts.quote: We'll be happy to refund you the full amount (not pro-rated) if you downgrade your subscription within three days of signing up for monthly billing

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states it will refund the full, non-prorated amount if a user downgrades within 30 days of signing up for annual billing.
facts.quote: or within 30 days of signing up for annual billing.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that prorated charges for accidentally added members can be refunded if requested within three days of the invoice date.
facts.quote: we're happy to provide a refund of the prorated charges if you reach out within three days of the invoice date

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that customers in the European Union can receive a full refund for a monthly subscription within 14 days of purchase under mandatory refund rules.
facts.quote: customers in the European Union can receive a full refund for a monthly subscription within 14 days of purchase, rather than 72 hours.

facts.fact: Notion's vendor states that under mandatory refund policies, monthly subscription refunds may be available past the standard 72-hour window.
facts.quote: you may be eligible for a monthly subscription refund past 72 hours.
